main.description: One drink, drunk once, by the author. Supersedes app.crystalcoupe.drinkLog, whose JSON and TypeScript definitions had drifted apart. The rating belongs to the drinker and describes the drink; `credits` attributes the people involved but carries no score, so a poor rating can never resolve to a judgement of a person.

venue.description: Absent for a pour at home.

menu.description: The menu sighting this was ordered from, if any.

deviations.description: How it missed, in the drinker's terms. This is what actually moves the palate coordinate.

palateShift.description: How this pour moved the author's coordinate, kept so the map's history can be replayed.

rating.description: A 9-point hedonic scale — the standard instrument for 'how much did you like this', and the right tool for feedback (as opposed to discovery).

wouldOrderAgain.description: Adoption rather than approval. This is what a recipe's reception is built from: 'reordered by 61%' credits a designer without ever producing a score that can shame one.
